A Send button pinches into a circle, spins while sending, then turns green and draws a tick.

The pinch is a clip-path inset with a strong ease-out and the tick draws with stroke-dashoffset, so one control shows every state.

A checkout shows a small spinner on the shipping line, then a larger one inside the Pay button.

The ring rotates while its stroke dash grows and shrinks, on mismatched periods, so it never repeats the same way twice in a row.

### Hold to delete

### Toast stack

Toast stack is a DOM effect: new toasts in front, older ones step back. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add toast-stack.

Toasts rise at the bottom right while older ones step back, smaller and higher, until the oldest fades.

Each toast’s transform comes from its stack index; dismissing the front one slides it off sideways and the rest step forward, all with transform and opacity transitions.

Renderer: DOM (CSS and the Web Animations API). Size: 5.3 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/toast-stack.html


## Springs & physics

### Squash & stretch bounce

Squash & stretch bounce is a DOM effect: stretch with speed, squash on impact. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add squash-bounce.

Tap Add to bag and a mug thumbnail arcs onto the bag icon, squashes, bounces and drops in.

It stretches along its velocity in flight and squashes on impact while keeping its area; each bounce keeps a fraction of its energy.

Settings: --gravity 2400 (600 to 5000, step 50; Gravity); --bounce 0.6 (0.3 to 0.95, step 0.01; Bounce); --squash 0.35 (0 to 0.7, step 0.01; Squash).
Renderer: DOM (CSS and the Web Animations API). Size: 12.3 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/squash-bounce.html

### Rubber-band drag

Rubber-band drag is a DOM effect: resistance grows past the edge, release springs back. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add rubber-band.

A photo viewer is swiped past its last photo, resisting more and more, then springs back on release.

Inside the album the photo tracks the finger 1:1; past the end, Apple’s rubber-band formula shrinks the follow, and the return spring starts with the hand’s release speed.

Settings: --constant 0.55 (0.1 to 1, step 0.01; Resistance); --stiffness 200 (60 to 600, step 10; Return stiffness).
Renderer: DOM (CSS and the Web Animations API). Size: 11.5 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/rubber-band.html

### Pendulum wave

Pendulum wave is a DOM effect: lengths tuned so the row drifts in and out of sync. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add pendulum-wave.

A row of glowing pendulums drifts from unison into travelling waves and snakes, then lines up again.

Each pendulum swings one more time per cycle than its neighbour: angle = A·cos(2π·n·t / cycle), with length ∝ 1 / frequency².

Settings: --count 15 (5 to 30, step 1; Pendulums); --cycle 30 (10 to 60, step 1; Cycle (s)).
Renderer: DOM (CSS and the Web Animations API). Size: 9.6 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/pendulum-wave.html

### Verlet rope

Verlet rope is a DOM effect: points remember where they were; lengths are enforced. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add verlet-rope.

A lamp’s pull cord swings and whips; a tug switches the light on or off.

Verlet integration moves each point by its last motion plus gravity, then a few constraint passes per frame restore neighbour rest lengths; the switch is a stiff spring.

Settings: --segments 24 (6 to 50, step 1; Segments); --gravity 900 (0 to 3000, step 50; Gravity); --iterations 8 (1 to 30, step 1; Iterations).
Renderer: DOM (CSS and the Web Animations API). Size: 13.0 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/verlet-rope.html

### Ball collisions

Ball collisions is a DOM effect: elastic impulses along the line between centres. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add ball-collisions.

Topic bubbles huddle together, and each tap grows one on a spring so it shoulders the others aside.

Bubbles are pulled gently to the middle; overlaps are separated by mass, and colliding pairs swap velocity along the line between centres, with restitution below 1.

Settings: --count 18 (4 to 24, step 1; Bubbles); --restitution 0.6 (0 to 1, step 0.01; Restitution).
Renderer: DOM (CSS and the Web Animations API). Size: 11.2 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/ball-collisions.html

### Snap-point bottom sheet

Snap-point bottom sheet is a DOM effect: aim with the throw, then spring to the nearest snap point. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add bottom-sheet.

A maps sheet of nearby cafés is flung between peek, half and full height.

On release it adds a short look-ahead of its velocity to its position, picks the nearest snap point and springs there with that speed; past the ends it rubber-bands.

Settings: --stiffness 380 (100 to 900, step 10; Stiffness); --bounce 0.15 (0 to 0.4, step 0.01; Bounce).
Renderer: DOM (CSS and the Web Animations API). Size: 11.1 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/bottom-sheet.html

### Chat heads

A dragged stack of chat bubbles trails the front one, and on release flies to the nearest edge.

### Jelly app icon

Jelly app icon is a DOM effect: a second spring turns speed into stretch. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add icon-jelly.

A long-pressed app icon is dragged to a new slot, stretching on the way and wobbling on landing.

Pulling an inbox down grows a spinner; the list holds on a shelf, then new mail slides in.

## Morph & SVG

### Shape morph

Shape morph is a Canvas effect: every shape is the same 160 polar radii. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add shape-morph.

Skipping a track morphs the album cover into the next track’s shape and colour as the title crossfades.

Every shape is stored as 160 distances from the centre at fixed angles, so any shape blends into any other point by point; equal mean radius keeps the area steady.

Settings: --hold 1600 (300 to 4000, step 50; Hold (ms)); --morph 600 (200 to 1500, step 10; Morph (ms)).
Renderer: Canvas 2D. Size: 7.7 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/shape-morph.html

### Icon morph

Icon morph is a DOM effect: two icons drawn with the same points, interpolated. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add icon-morph.

A download arrow folds into a check when saved, and a list icon’s bars regroup into a grid.

The arrow and tick share the same number of points, so they blend point by point; the view toggle blends each rectangle’s position and size.

Settings: --duration 280 (100 to 800, step 10; Morph (ms)).
Renderer: DOM (CSS and the Web Animations API). Size: 9.8 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/icon-morph.html

### Gooey blobs

Gooey blobs is a DOM effect: blur, then a hard alpha threshold. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add gooey.

A notes app’s add button oozes its actions out one by one and drains them back in.

The circles are blurred together, then an SVG colour-matrix filter cranks alpha contrast, turning the soft overlap into a hard liquid bridge; icons sit above the filter.

Settings: --blur 10 (4 to 20, step 1; Blur); --blobs 3 (2 to 4, step 1; Actions).
Renderer: DOM (CSS and the Web Animations API). Size: 7.7 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/gooey.html

### Line draw-on

Line draw-on is a DOM effect: stroke-dasharray equals the path length. One plain JavaScript file with no dependencies; add it with npx motion-library add line-draw.

Two lines on an analytics card trace the week left to right, the second just after the first.

Set the dash length and dash offset to the path’s getTotalLength(), then animate the offset to zero so the line draws itself.

Settings: --duration 1600 (500 to 4000, step 50; Draw (ms)).
Renderer: DOM (CSS and the Web Animations API). Size: 5.5 KB. Reduced motion: yes. Page: https://ajeckblad.github.io/motion-library/fx/line-draw.html

### Liquid button

The Place order button’s edge ripples like liquid as the pointer passes, and squeezes in on press.

### Dynamic island
